subject.title: Cron allows invalid Feishu announce jobs without delivery.to, causing runtime delivery failure

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh one of the open fork PRs that close #39599, or close both and allow a narrow replacement fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but duplicate open fork candidates already exist and one is known unsafe while the other is narrower, so automation should pause until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Refresh or adopt PR #135
options.body: Use the cleaner fork PR as the starting point for the focused gateway/service validation fix, with regression coverage and any needed maintainer edits.

options.title: Close both and replace
options.body: Close the conflicting fork PRs, then allow a new narrow fix PR that credits the prior attempts and preserves the issue evidence.

options.title: Split UX follow-ups
options.body: Keep this issue focused on create-time validation and file separate work for cron audit and clearer existing-job diagnostics.
